title: Outbox acks poison events
raw_content:
Exploring the outbox worker to see how acknowledgments interact with publish failures.
The bug is that `outbox.ack()` runs for every row in the loop, even when `publish` fails — so poison events get acked and vanish. Move `ack` into the success path only.

<arch_final>
{"patch": "--- a/worker/outbox_worker.py
+++ b/worker/outbox_worker.py
